title: QUIZ - 90
description: Test your knowledge, strengthen your reasoning, and learn something new with every question.

questions.learningObjective: Calculate the horizontal distance between two points that share a y-coordinate
questions.question: Two points on a graph are (-1, 1) and (7, 1). Since they share the same y-coordinate, what is the horizontal distance between them?
questions.explanation: When two points share a y-coordinate, the distance between them is the absolute difference of their x-coordinates: |7 - -1| = 8.
questions.hint: For two points on the same horizontal line, distance is the absolute difference of the x-coordinates.

questions.learningObjective: Determine which quadrant a point lies in based on the signs of its coordinates
questions.question: In which quadrant does the point (4, 6) lie?
questions.explanation: Since x is positive and y is positive, the point lies in Quadrant I.
questions.hint: Quadrant I has (+,+), Quadrant II has (-,+), Quadrant III has (-,-), and Quadrant IV has (+,-).

questions.learningObjective: Determine a point's coordinates from a description of its position relative to the origin
questions.question: A point on a graph is located 8 units left of the origin and 4 units up from the origin. What are its coordinates?
questions.explanation: Horizontal position (x) is -8 (left of origin) and vertical position (y) is 4 (up from origin), giving coordinates (-8, 4).
questions.hint: The first coordinate is the horizontal position; the second coordinate is the vertical position.
